This avatar has already brought me a client. But then the interesting part began.

The client decided to expand the project and asked if I could create a German version of the video.

I wasn't prepared for that. 🤷‍♀️

I work in four languages, but German isn't one of them. I don't understand the language at all. I honestly have no idea how the words are even supposed to be pronounced!

Still, I was curious, so I immediately started looking for a platform that could translate the video without losing quality.

In the end, I decided to try Synthesia Video Translator. I sent the video to the client... A couple of days later, he came back with a new order for several more videos.

So in 2026, not speaking a language is no longer a barrier to working with international clients. You just need the right tools.

Thanks to Synthesia for providing me with access to AI Video Translator so I could test it.

If you'd like to try the FREE AI Video Translator in 130+ languages, comment "X" below and I'll send you the link.

Sometimes advertising isn't about selling a product,  it's about the aesthetic.

This video is my creative interpretation inspired by the design of SATO eyewear.

I didn't try to recreate the original model. Instead, I changed it and adapted it to my own vision.

I wanted to show that eyewear advertising doesn't have to revolve around the product itself. Contrast, camera movement, editing rhythm, music, and the overall atmosphere can turn an ordinary accessory into an object of desire.

I experimented with the presentation. What do you think?

Sometimes, one piece of work opens an unexpected door.

You simply create. Experiment with visuals, movement, stories. You share your work — and you never really know who might see it on the other side of the screen.

More often than not, that's exactly how people find you.

And since this opportunity came my way, I've decided to pass the baton on. If you create films and have been thinking about showing your work to a wider audience for a while — maybe this is your sign.
